How is this worked out?

Each requirement of your program is matched to your record. A passed course or accepted transfer credit is Done, a course you are registered in this term is In progress, and anything else is Remaining. Courses outside the named requirements fill your elective slots. Progress = completed requirement credits ÷ 120.
